content:
Swapping to a new phone often comes with one hidden cost: if the size changes, you need a new case.

For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, that might seem like an unavoidable expense — but two accessory makers aren't convinced, and one of them is betting big on that idea...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter of an Otterbox case already on sale at Best Buy, noting that it's compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro. In the bottom right corner of the packaging, it reads in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself isn't entirely sold, commenting: "Seems a bit early to be talking about this." However, Astropad's Matt Ronge — whose company makes anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones — says his suppliers have told him the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, a leaker claimed that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but materials later leaked from iPhone suppliers also indicated the iPhone 18 Pro would be two millimetres thicker than the previous generation.

If true, that would continue an existing trend, as both iPhone 17 Pro models were thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

Not all leakers agree, however — some say the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide case makers with dimensional information ahead of time so third-party cases can go on sale alongside new iPhones. On the other hand, accessory makers sometimes place orders based purely on rumours, and they end up being wrong. Personally, I won't pre-order a case until I see the new iPhone in person.
